description: Find where an email was delayed. Paste the message's Received: header lines (or the whole header block); get back each hop in order from the first server to the last, its time in UTC, the delay from the hop before (from the Date field for the first hop when it is pasted), the largest gap and which server it was at, the total time, and hops whose clocks disagree. Addresses, IP addresses and message ids in the headers are read past, never echoed and never stored. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/email-header-hops). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

headers.description: The Received: header lines as they appear in the message (other header lines are ignored; a Date: line is used as the send time). Not stored.
examples:
Received: by mx.example.net with ESMTPS; Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:00:20 +0000
Received: from a.example by b.example with ESMTP; Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:00:05 +0000
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:00:00 +0000

order.description: How the lines are pasted: newest_first (default, the order in the message, because each server adds its line on top) or oldest_first.

name: email_header_hops
title: Email Received-Header Hops
